The '''electro sword''' was the primary weapon wielded by the [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]]. The blade resonated a blue electric current, and was effective in both close combat and also when thrown.<ref name="Bounty" />

==History==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], [[Krismo Sodi/Legends|Krismo Sodi]] led his [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] on a mission to board a [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] transporting a chest to the [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] ruler, [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]]. The chest contained Sodi's kidnapped [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|sister]]. Kage Warriors used electro swords and [[Unarmed combat/Legends|martial arts]] to overpower most of the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] hired by the Belugans to [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|protect the cargo]]. When he was opposed by [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rigosso/Legends|Rigosso]], Sodi hurled his electro sword at the Belugan officer, impaling him through the chest. While the blade was very deadly, it was no match for a [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], as shown when [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] [[Sun djem/Legends|severed]] the blades of three Kage Warriors in one slash.<ref name="Bounty" />
